C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER-V2.IntentSummary: Deliver one stable adaptive + Добавить entry point and universal immutable document router by composing existing feature launchers, worker classifiers/materializers and a non-destructive protocol-to-meeting merge, with rank-only learning and deterministic degraded fallback.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: define the universal action and immutable document routing state machine

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The flow opens with immediate static actions, accepts a file before type questions, preserves documentId after upload, distinguishes processing, exact destination, review and failed/degraded states, and never requires a second upload.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: define one stable Action Center shell for desktop and mobile

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Desktop and mobile keep a fixed title/search-upload region, exactly three recommendation slots, fixed groups, stable controls, keyboard focus, Escape close and focus restoration.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: specify restrained continuity and reduced-motion behavior

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Open, close and state transitions are short and interruption-safe; prefers-reduced-motion removes spatial motion while preserving text, focus order and controls.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data: preserve provenance, idempotency and rank-only preference safety

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No migration is added; immutable documents, extraction runs, review items, evidence and ui_choice_preferences remain the durable stores; action.center.action accepts only known safe IDs and automatic routing never learns.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement safe protocol reuse and exact destination identity

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Protocol persistence returns an exact meeting ID for create and safe reuse, repeated processing is idempotent, missing compatible facts may be added, and conflicts remain non-destructive review items with evidence.

T-006.Title: kafedra-feature: implement the Action Registry, adaptive shell and universal upload router

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: + Добавить, Ctrl/Cmd+N and calendar-day plus use the same shell; existing feature launchers remain authoritative; exact worker result IDs route to exact objects; filters cannot hide the routed destination; static fallback works without preferences.

T-007.Title: kafedra-design-audit: independently audit hierarchy, continuity and accessibility

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The independent audit checks stable geometry, upload progress, exact destination continuity, interruption, static state, Tab/Shift+Tab focus containment, desktop/mobile equivalence and reduced motion.

T-008.Title: kafedra-tests: verify ranking, routing, protocol merge and degraded responsive flows

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit, integration and Playwright tests cover explicit context over frequency, allowlist rejection, exact routing, idempotent protocol reuse, conflict preservation, generic fallback, local preference fallback, desktop, mobile and reduced motion.

T-009.Title: kafedra-release: prove unchanged schema and offline deployment invariants

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No dependency or migration is added; backup/restore, release, offline and exact-head project CI remain mandatory before squash merge and terminal archive transition.
